context.body: The same obstacles remain in Caleb’s memory, but decades of delay do not erase his earlier report or hope.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

context.body: Another spying mission and the delayed inheritance · Joshua 14:6–15
context.label: Canonical location

observations.body: Caleb recalls being forty when Moses sent him from Kadesh Barnea and bringing back an honest report while others made the people afraid.
observations.label: Caleb receives the land he followed the LORD to seek: action

observations.body: At eighty-five he asks for the hill country, still names Anakim and fortified cities, and trusts that the LORD may drive them out.
observations.label: Caleb receives the land he followed the LORD to seek: response

observations.body: forty years old · brought word in my heart · followed fully · eighty-five · drive them out
observations.label: Words in Joshua 14:6–15

payload.posture: Read Joshua 14:6–15 as another spying mission and the delayed inheritance evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: Caleb’s “perhaps” preserves dependence on the LORD rather than turning his survival into self-sufficiency.
payload.title: Caleb receives the land he followed the LORD to seek
